title: Account Standing Uplift: Account Security Q&A — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
**Rule.** This rule covers the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card. For the credit given on filing on an incorrect-amount dispute of a single-use virtual card purchase, the standing uplift is:

- **4.00**, when the linked Pocketwire Personal Account has never been restricted;
- **2.00**, when its most recent limitation was lifted 12 or more whole months before the filing date;
- **0.00**, when it is restricted now, or when its most recent limitation was lifted fewer than 12 whole months before the filing date.

The account's standing is read from the records of the Pocketwire Personal Account: the restriction reason on the account, which shows none on an account never restricted, and the date its most recent limitation was lifted.

### Questions and answers (hypothetical accounts)

**Q. The personal account has never had a limitation or lock. What is the standing uplift?**
The account has never been restricted, so the uplift is 4.00.

**Q. A limitation was lifted 14 whole months before the filing date.**
14 is 12 or more, so the uplift is 2.00.

**Q. A limitation was lifted exactly 12 whole months before the filing date.**
12 is "12 or more", so the uplift is 2.00.

**Q. A limitation was lifted 11 whole months before the filing date.**
11 is fewer than 12, so the uplift is 0.00.

**Q. The account is restricted at the time of filing.**
The uplift is 0.00.
